dialogue.speaker: Orac
dialogue.text: Good news: the distribution grid is working.

dialogue.speaker: Rob
dialogue.text: It has recognized an unauthorized removal. Stay below the rim. The upper batteries cannot track us in the channel.

dialogue.speaker: Orac
dialogue.text: Two security needles. Unmanned. Amber lines mean a laser lock. Break away before they turn red.

dialogue.speaker: Rob
dialogue.text: Service bridge ahead. Pass below it. Your hull will fit.

dialogue.speaker: Orac
dialogue.text: Entering the covered section. Keep the nose steady; there is less room above us.

dialogue.speaker: Rob
dialogue.text: Wall laser turrets. The amber line locks before the burst. Move off it, or use solid cover.

dialogue.speaker: Orac
dialogue.text: That is a closed gate, Rob.

dialogue.speaker: Rob
dialogue.text: A service lock. I can request a maintenance opening. Center the ship.

dialogue.speaker: Orac
dialogue.text: Relay marker recorded. Broken machinery ahead. Watch the gaps and your altitude. Two more wall turrets in the final cut.

dialogue.speaker: Orac
dialogue.text: Tracking coverage is falling away. Stay low until we clear the last pylon.

dialogue.speaker: Rob
dialogue.text: Clear of the batteries. You can climb.

dialogue.speaker: Jason
dialogue.text: Next time we take something that is already unplugged.
